title: Higher order quasiconvexity reduces to quasiconvexity
abstract_scope: Smooth strictly 2-quasiconvex functions with p-growth, p>1, can be extended from symmetric matrices to classical quasiconvex functions with the same growth. Preserve the actual theorem conditions.
note: Primary source located through the Ultra parent public activity; do not infer equivalence of polynomial formulae, constants or uncorrected general-U density.
